ucs.title: [LLM] Conti/Wizard Spider pre-encryption recovery destruction (vssadmin + wbadmin + bcdedit chain)
ucs.description: Hunts the signature 'inhibit recovery' burst Conti drops seconds before mass file encryption — Volume Shadow Copy deletion, backup-catalog wipe, and Windows Recovery Environment disable. This exact command stack appears in the leaked Conti playbook and FIN12 incident reports as the final pre-encryptor step.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete*" AND Processes.process="*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" AND Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name=wbadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete*" AND (Processes.process="*catalog*" OR Processes.process="*systemstatebackup*")) OR (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*" OR Processes.process="*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*"))) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval recovery_op=case(process_name="vssadmin.exe" OR process_name="wmic.exe","shadow_delete", process_name="wbadmin.exe","backup_delete", process_name="bcdedit.exe","recovery_disable") | bin _time span=10m | stats dc(recovery_op) as op_types values(process) as cmds values(parent_process_name) as parents min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by dest user _time | where op_types>=2 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
    or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
    or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalog","systemstatebackup"))
    or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled","ignoreallfailures","bootstatuspolicy"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend RecoveryOp = case(
    FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe"), "shadow_delete",
    FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe", "backup_delete",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe", "recovery_disable", "")
| summarize OpTypes = make_set(RecoveryOp), Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName), Count = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 10m)   // 10m = Conti runs whole chain in seconds-to-minutes
| where array_length(OpTypes) >= 2     // >=2 distinct recovery-kill ops = far higher fidelity than any single command
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend FileName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where (FileName == "vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
    or (FileName == "wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete")
    or (FileName == "wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has_any ("catalog","systemstatebackup"))
    or (FileName == "bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled","ignoreallfailures","bootstatuspolicy"))
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend RecoveryOp = case(
    FileName in ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe"), "shadow_delete",
    FileName == "wbadmin.exe", "backup_delete",
    FileName == "bcdedit.exe", "recovery_disable", "")
| summarize OpTypes = make_set(RecoveryOp), Cmds = make_set(CommandLine),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName), Count = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
          by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where array_length(OpTypes) >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Conti/Wizard Spider System Recovery Inhibition Chain
id: 8c2f1d44-9a3e-4f0b-b6c1-2e7d4a91f0a2
status: experimental
description: Detects the shadow-copy deletion, backup-catalog wipe and recovery-environment disable commands Conti/FIN12 executes immediately before ransomware encryption.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  vss:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  wmic_vss:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  wbadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'delete'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'catalog'
      - 'systemstatebackup'
  bcdedit:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'recoveryenabled'
      - 'ignoreallfailures'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy'
  condition: vss or wmic_vss or wbadmin or bcdedit
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate backup software maintenance windows
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1489
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\Vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete*shadows* OR *Delete*Shadows*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy*delete* OR *Shadowcopy*Delete*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\Wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete*catalog* OR *delete*systemstatebackup*)) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\Bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*recoveryenabled* OR *ignoreallfailures* OR *bootstatuspolicy*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wmic|wbadmin|bcdedit)\.exe$/i
| (regex("(?i)delete.*shadows", field=CommandLine) OR regex("(?i)shadowcopy.*delete", field=CommandLine) OR regex("(?i)delete.*(catalog|systemstatebackup)", field=CommandLine) OR regex("(?i)(recoveryenabled|ignoreallfailures|bootstatuspolicy)", field=CommandLine))
| recoveryOp := if(regex("(?i)(vssadmin|wmic)", field=ImageFileName), then="shadow_delete", else=if(regex("(?i)wbadmin", field=ImageFileName), then="backup_delete", else="recovery_disable"))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[count(as=evt_count), collect([recoveryOp, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName])])
| count(recoveryOp, distinct=true, as=op_types)
| op_types >= 2
ucs.rationale: Conti/FIN12 is defined by its high-tempo, scripted endgame: the leaked Conti manual and DFIR-Report intrusions show vssadmin delete shadows /all, wmic shadowcopy delete, wbadmin delete catalog, and bcdedit /set recoveryenabled no fired back-to-back by the encryptor or its batch wrapper. Requiring >=2 distinct recovery-kill operations in a 10-minute window keys on Conti's characteristic multi-comma

ucs.title: [LLM] Wizard Spider AD reconnaissance burst (AdFind trustdmp + nltest domain_trusts + net admins) preceding lateral movement
ucs.description: Hunts the clustered Active Directory enumeration Conti operators run from the adfind.bat playbook — AdFind trust/subnet/group dumps alongside nltest domain-trust discovery and net group 'Domain Admins' queries — which characteristically precedes Cobalt Strike lateral movement and domain-wide encryption.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process="*adfind*" AND (Processes.process="*trustdmp*" OR Processes.process="*objectcategory=*" OR Processes.process="*-subnets*" OR Processes.process="*-gcb*")) OR (Processes.process_name=nltest.exe AND (Processes.process="*/domain_trusts*" OR Processes.process="*/dclist*" OR Processes.process="*/all_trusts*")) OR (Processes.process_name IN (net.exe,net1.exe) AND (Processes.process="*domain admins*" OR Processes.process="*enterprise admins*"))) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval recon=case(like(process,"%adfind%"),"adfind", process_name="nltest.exe","nltest", process_name="net.exe" OR process_name="net1.exe","net_admins") | bin _time span=1h | stats dc(recon) as recon_types values(recon) as recon_tools values(process) as cmds values(parent_process_name) as parents count by dest user _time | where recon_types>=2 | sort - _time
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend ReconType = case(
    ProcessCommandLine has "adfind" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("trustdmp","objectcategory=","-subnets","-gcb"), "adfind",
    FileName =~ "nltest.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/domain_trusts","/dclist","/all_trusts"), "nltest",
    FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("domain admins","enterprise admins"), "net_admins",
    "")
| where isnotempty(ReconType)
| summarize ReconTypes = make_set(ReconType), Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName), Count = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where array_length(ReconTypes) >= 2   // >=2 distinct recon tool classes in 1h = scripted adfind.bat sweep, not ad-hoc admin
| order by LastSeen desc
